# Controller
## Startup
Communication must be initialized before the actuator to reject stale commands.
```python
initialize_communication()
enable_actuator()
```
This order is mandatory even after a warm restart.

# Recovery
## Recovery order
The violet snapshot is approved only for the auxiliary controller.
```sh
stop_auxiliary
restore_snapshot violet
verify_auxiliary
```
Never apply this snapshot to the main controller.

## Main controller
